  • Constructor Details

    • InventoryItem

      InventoryItem(int id, String name, int quantity, int minimumQuantity, String unit)
      Creates an inventory item row.
      Parameters:
      id - the inventory item's database ID
      name - the name of the item
      quantity - the amount currently in stock
      minimumQuantity - the minimum stock level before restocking is needed
      unit - the unit the quantity is measured in
